detailed_descriptions.en: Mech combat at a grand scale : Engage in combined arms combat where you pilot any unit under your command. From small skirmishes to epic battles, conquer rivals as you build a stellar empire. Drop into combat . Either alone, leading your squad, or commanding an army. Take part in the evolving battlefield, with fully destructible debris and unit wreckage. Customize and level up your pilots as they gain experience. Build elite squads of battle hardened soldiers, or rush your opponent with disposable rookies. Personalize your empire and modify your Mech , Tank, VTOL, or Battle Armour to suit the mission at hand. Wage war across the star cluster in a procedural campaign. Face logistic and tactical decisions as you vie for control of strategic resources, pivotal systems, manufacturing hubs, and political objectives. Completed or failed mission objectives will have serious consequences as they impact future campaign operations. Champions will rise across the cluster, and establish pirate factions, mercenary companies, or even rival empires! Conduct diplomacy with planetary governments and rivals. Strike a balance between empire growth and peaceful coexistence, or wage war without regard to the consequences...

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Mech combat at a grand scale: Engage in combined arms combat where you pilot any unit under your command. From small skirmishes to epic battles, conquer rivals as you build a stellar empire.

Drop into combat. Either alone, leading your squad, or commanding an army. Take part in the evolving battlefield, with fully destructible debris and unit wreckage.

Customize and level up your pilots as they gain experience. Build elite squads of battle hardened soldiers, or rush your opponent with disposable rookies. Personalize your empire and modify your Mech, Tank, VTOL, or Battle Armour to suit the mission at hand.

Wage war across the star cluster in a procedural campaign. Face logistic and tactical decisions as you vie for control of strategic resources, pivotal systems, manufacturing hubs, and political objectives.

Completed or failed mission objectives will have serious consequences as they impact future campaign operations. Champions will rise across the cluster, and establish pirate factions, mercenary companies, or even rival empires!

Conduct diplomacy with planetary governments and rivals. Strike a balance between empire growth and peaceful coexistence, or wage war without regard to the consequences...
